meta.titre: Structure of an argumentative essay in English

sections.contenu_markdown: The strongest argumentative essays don't ignore the other side of the debate — they acknowledge it, then explain why their own position still holds.

An argumentative essay in English follows a clear structure: an introduction presenting the issue and a thesis statement, body paragraphs each developing one argument with supporting evidence and examples, and a conclusion restating the writer's position; a balanced essay may acknowledge opposing views before refuting or nuancing them.
sections.formule_principale: Introduction (issue + thesis) → Body paragraphs (one argument each) → Conclusion (restated position)

sections.enonce_markdown: Plan an essay on: 'Should nuclear power be used as the main source of energy?'

etapes.action: Write the introduction with a thesis statement
etapes.justification: State the topic and the writer's clear position from the start.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Thesis: nuclear power should not be the main source

etapes.justification: A balanced essay briefly presents the counter-argument (nuclear's real advantages).
Each body paragraph develops one distinct reason supporting the thesis.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Paragraphs on risks (meltdowns, waste) and alternatives (wind, solar)

etapes.justification: The conclusion should summarise and reaffirm the thesis.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Conclusion: nuclear power should remain limited, not the main source

sections.conclusion_markdown: A well-structured argumentative essay moves from a clear thesis, through a balanced consideration of both sides, to a reaffirmed conclusion.

items.erreur_markdown: Writing a one-sided essay that completely ignores the opposing viewpoint.
items.pourquoi_faux: Examiners value essays that demonstrate awareness of the debate's complexity; a purely one-sided essay appears less sophisticated and less convincing.
items.correction_markdown: Always dedicate at least one short paragraph to the opposing viewpoint before refuting or nuancing it.

items.enonce_markdown: What should the introduction of an argumentative essay always contain?
items.solution_markdown: A brief presentation of the issue and a clear thesis statement stating the writer's position.

items_markdown: Body: one argument per paragraph, with evidence
Acknowledge the counter-argument for a stronger essay
